div.p: ADR-019 (chosen) — write → deliver → backstop → read, system-wide

g.text: atomic db.batch() → Neon · single BEGIN…COMMIT array-transaction (adr017)
Neon Postgres · canonical domain rows (leads · message_queue · conversations · lot_matches)
durable workers · own live control state · idempotency key = outbox row id
3 · hourly sweep · processed_at IS NULL AND age > 30s
5 · write output rows (control state stays in Inngest)
6 · read canonical rows · never the event tape
